9de49d2e6591: Click a book tile on a project card. A book you have not opened before starts in Understand. A book you have worked in opens where you left it.
404cbc6454ad: To come back to Home, click the translationCore logo at the top left.
60041fbe2101: To go straight back to the verse you last edited, click the blue banner or Resume →. See Resume where you left off.
848f85bf9caa: The project you used last is always at the top of the list. The line under a project's name shows its language code, how many books it has, and whether it is only on this computer or shared on Door43.
06dd734275f1: Click + Add a project, then choose one of the five cards.
f369146ea028: New Bible starts a new Bible translation. See Create a Bible project.
911410168f48: New Open Bible Stories starts the 50 stories. See Start an Open Bible Stories project.
70cb1f009fe5: Import a project brings in a translationCore 3 project. See Import a translationCore 3 project. To start from USFM files or a Scripture Burrito, choose New Bible.
75949453dbec: Open a project from Door43 opens a Bible your team shares on Door43. See Working as a team on several computers.
cce4fc1c0bff: Receive work from a file opens a teammate's exchange file from a USB stick.
4d7d976bc116: To close the dialog without choosing, press Esc or click ✕.
fad9a4a7b20c: Settings on the card opens Project settings: the checking language, text direction and script font. See Project settings.
26f54b9401d5: Add a book adds another book to the project.
b71faf7e7849: Share on Door43 uploads a copy of the project to Door43. See Share to Door43.
44dae5870986: Save or receive work by USB saves your work to a file, or reads a teammate's, for teams that work without the internet.
6e36dc9eeb58: Click the round person icon at the top right. The menu is the same on Home and inside a project.
15fc63a68e57: Sign in to Door43 so you can share projects.
5a5b5c4a7416: Use the internet turns the internet on or off for translationCore. While it is off, a step that needs the internet asks first.
65a77caedbe8: Help and guides opens the offline help that ships with the app. You can browse and search with no internet.
8649cf81da70: App language changes the language of the menus and buttons. See Change the app language.
ab23ad466187: Report a problem opens a form that sends a message to the unfoldingWord help desk.
